newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Schindler to expand N.America facility.
newsitem.headline: Schindler to expand N.America facility.

text.p: Schindler AG said its Schindler Elevator Corp unit in the U.S. plans to expand its escalator manufacturing facility in Clinton, North Carolina, by an additional 2,790 square meters.
The expansion is aimed at accommodating further growth and will enable the company to diversify product offerings, Schindler said.
The Clinton plant currently has a 2,790 square meter escalator step manufacturing facility and a 9,300 square meter escalator assembly plant which will now be expanded by the additional 2,790 meters.
